calls.title: Gaurav / Christian
calls.summary: Gaurav Rana (InMobi) discussed pain points with GrowthBook’s enterprise license, including the inability to test upgrades in pre-prod without additional test seats, the difficulty of adding new variations to running experiments without duplicating them (causing human error), and the lack of robust approval flows for experiment changes. Christian Liebenow (new GrowthBook account manager) agreed to escalate these requests to the engineering team and Jeremy/Graham. Next steps: Christian will provide updates by early next week via Slack regarding the test license, experiment variation feature, and approval flow improvements.
